mn35:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
mn35:2.1: tena kho pana samayena saccako nigaṇṭhaputto vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati bhassappavādiko paṇḍitavādo sādhusammato bahujanassa.
mn35:2.2: so vesāliyaṃ parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
mn35:2.3: “nāhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ. –
mn35:2.4: thūṇañce pahaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ, sāpi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya.
mn35:3.1: atha kho āyasmā assaji pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn35:3.2: addasā kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto vesāliyaṃ jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn35:3.3: disvāna yenāyasmā assaji tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā assajinā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn35:3.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca:
mn35:4.1: “kathaṃ pana bho assaji samaṇo gotamo sāvake vineti, kathambhāgā ca pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattatī”ti.
mn35:4.2: evaṃ kho aggivessana bhagavā sāvake vineti, evambhāgā ca pana bhagavato sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattati:
mn35:4.3: “rūpaṃ bhikkhave aniccaṃ, vedanā aniccā, saññā aniccā, saṅkhārā aniccā, viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ.
mn35:4.4: rūpaṃ bhikkhave anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā.
mn35:4.5: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā, sabbe dhammā anattā”ti.
mn35:4.6: evaṃ kho aggivessana bhagavā sāvake vineti. evambhāgā ca pana bhagavato sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattatīti.
mn35:4.7: “dussutaṃ vata bho assaji assumha, ye mayaṃ evaṃvādiṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ assumha.
mn35:4.8: appevanāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ samāgaccheyyāma, appevanāma siyā kocideva kathāsallāpo, appevanāma tasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā viveceyyāmā”ti.
mn35:5.1: tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni licchavisatāni santhāgāre sannipatitāni honti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
mn35:5.2: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto yena te licchavī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te licchavī etadavoca:
mn35:5.3: “abhikkamantu bhonto licchavī! abhikkamantu bhonto licchavī! ajja me samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo bhavissati.
mn35:5.4: sace me samaṇo gotamo tathā patiṭṭhissati, yathāssa me ñātaññatarena sāvakena assajinā nāma bhikkhunā patiṭṭhitaṃ, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya,
mn35:5.5: evamevāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi. –
mn35:5.6: seyyathāpi nāma balavā soṇḍikākammakāro mahantaṃ soṇḍikākilañjaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipitvā kaṇṇe gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya,
mn35:5.7: evamevāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
mn35:5.8: seyyathāpi nāma balavā soṇḍikādhutto vālaṃ kaṇṇe gahetvā odhuneyya niddhuneyya nicchodeyya,
mn35:5.9: evamevāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ odhunissāmi niddhunissāmi nicchodessāmi.
mn35:5.10: seyyathāpi nāma kuñjaro saṭṭhihāyano gambhīraṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogahetvā. saṇadhovikaṃ nāma kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷati,
mn35:5.11: evamevāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ saṇadhovikaṃ maññe kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷissāmi.
mn35:5.12: abhikkamantu bhonto licchavī! abhikkamantu bhonto licchavī! ajja me samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo bhavissatī”ti.
mn35:6.2: “kiṃ samaṇo gotamo saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa vādaṃ āropessati, atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropessatī”ti.
mn35:6.4: “kiṃ so bhavamāno saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavato vādaṃ āropessati, atha kho bhagavā saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa vādaṃ āropessatī”ti.
mn35:6.5: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto pañcamattehi licchavisatehi parivuto yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā tenupasaṅkami.
mn35:7.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū abbhokāse caṅkamanti.
mn35:7.2: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
mn35:7.3: kahaṃ nu kho bho etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati?
mn35:7.4: dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamanti.
mn35:7.5: “esaggivessana bhagavā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisinno”ti.
mn35:8.1: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto mahatiyā licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ mahāvanaṃ ajjhogahetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn35:8.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn35:8.3: tepi kho licchavī appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn35:9.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:9.2: puccheyyāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ kañcideva desaṃ, sace me bhavaṃ gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
mn35:9.4: “kathaṃ pana bhavaṃ gotamo sāvake vineti, kathambhāgā ca pana bhoto gotamassa sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattatī”ti.
mn35:9.5: evaṃ kho ahaṃ aggivessana sāvake vinemi, evambhāgā ca pana me sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattati:
mn35:9.6: rūpaṃ bhikkhave aniccaṃ, vedanā aniccā, saññā aniccā, saṅkhārā aniccā, viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ.
mn35:9.7: rūpaṃ bhikkhave anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā.
mn35:9.8: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā, sabbe dhammā anattāti.
mn35:9.9: evaṃ kho ahaṃ aggivessana sāvake vinemi, evambhāgā ca pana me sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattatīti.
mn35:10.3: “seyyathāpi bho gotama ye kecime bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti, sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya
mn35:10.4: evamete bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti.
mn35:10.5: seyyathāpi vā pana bho gotama ye kecime balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti, sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya
mn35:10.7: evameva kho bho gotama rūpattāyaṃ purisapuggalo rūpe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati. vedanattāyaṃ purisapuggalo vedanāyaṃ patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati. saññattāyaṃ purisapuggalo saññāyaṃ patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati. saṅkhārattāyaṃ purisapuggalo saṅkhāresu patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati. viññāṇattāyaṃ purisapuggalo viññāṇe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavatī”ti.
mn35:11.2: “rūpaṃ me attā, vedanā me attā, saññā me attā, saṅkhārā me attā, viññāṇaṃ me attā”ti.
mn35:11.4: rūpaṃ me attā, vedanā me attā, saññā me attā, saṅkhārā me attā, viññāṇaṃ me attāti. ayañca mahatī janatā”ti.
mn35:11.5: kiṃ hi te aggivessana mahatī janatā karissati,
mn35:11.6: iṅgha tvaṃ aggivessana sakaṃyeva vādaṃ nibbeṭhehī”ti.
mn35:11.8: rūpaṃ me attā, vedanā me attā, saññā me attā, saṅkhārā me attā, viññāṇaṃ me attā”ti.
mn35:12.1: tena hi aggivessana taṃ yevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
mn35:12.3: vatteyya rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa sakasmiṃ vijite vaso:
mn35:12.4: ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ, jāpetāyaṃ vā jāpetuṃ, pabbājetāyaṃ vā pabbājetuṃ – seyyathāpi rañño pasenadissa kosalassa, seyyathāpi vā pana rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassāti?
mn35:12.5: “vatteyya bho gotama rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa sakasmiṃ vijite vaso:
mn35:12.6: ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ, jāpetāyaṃ vā jāpetuṃ, pabbājetāyaṃ vā pabbājetuṃ – seyyathāpi rañño pasenadissa kosalassa, seyyathāpi vā pana rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa.
mn35:12.7: imesampi hi bho gotama saṅghānaṃ gaṇānaṃ –
mn35:12.10: ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ, jāpetāyaṃ vā jāpetuṃ, pabbājetāyaṃ vā pabbājetuṃ.
mn35:12.11: kiṃ pana rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa seyyathāpi rañño pasenadissa kosalassa, seyyathāpi vā pana rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehi puttassa?
mn35:13.3: rūpaṃ me attāti, vattati te tasmiṃ rūpe vaso:
mn35:13.4: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti?
mn35:13.5: evaṃ vutte saccako nigaṇṭhaputto tuṇhī ahosi.
mn35:13.6: dutiyampi kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:13.7: taṃ kiṃ maññasi aggivessana, yaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi:
mn35:13.8: rūpaṃ me attāti, vattati te tasmiṃ rūpe vaso:
mn35:13.9: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti?
mn35:13.10: dutiyampi kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto tuṇhī ahosi.
mn35:13.11: atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:13.12: byākarohi’dāni aggivessana, nadāni te tuṇhībhāvassa kālo.
mn35:13.13: yo koci aggivessana tathāgatena yāvatatiyaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākaroti, etthevassa sattadhā muddhā phalatīti.
mn35:14.1: tena kho pana samayena vajirapāṇi yakkho āyasaṃ vajiraṃ ādāya ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa uparivehāsaṃ ṭhito hoti:
mn35:14.2: “sacāyaṃ saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavatā yāvatatiyaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākarissati, etthevassa sattadhā muddhaṃ phālessāmī”ti.
mn35:14.3: taṃ kho pana vajirapāṇiṃ yakkhaṃ bhagavā ceva passati, saccako ca nigaṇṭhaputto.
mn35:14.4: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃyeva tāṇaṃ gavesī, bhagavantaṃyeva leṇaṃ gavesī, bhagavantaṃyeva saraṇaṃ gavesī, bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:15.3: rūpaṃ me attāti, vattati te tasmiṃ rūpe vaso
mn35:15.4: “evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu. evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī”ti.
mn35:16.3: na kho te sandhīyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.
mn35:16.6: vedanā me attāti, vattati te tāyaṃ vedanāyaṃ vaso
mn35:16.7: “evaṃ me vedanā hotu. evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī”ti.
mn35:17.3: na kho te sandhīyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.
mn35:17.6: saññā me attāti, vattati te tāyaṃ saññāyaṃ vaso
mn35:17.7: “evaṃ me saññā hotu. evaṃ me saññā mā ahosī”ti.
mn35:18.3: na kho te sandhīyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.
mn35:18.6: saṅkhārā me attāti, vattati te tesu saṅkhāresu vaso
mn35:18.7: “evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu. evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesu”nti.
mn35:19.3: na kho te sandhīyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.
mn35:19.6: viññāṇaṃ me attāti, vattati te tasmiṃ viññāṇe vaso
mn35:19.7: “evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu. evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī”ti.
mn35:20.3: na kho te sandhīyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.
mn35:20.7: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
mn35:20.9: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn35:20.10: etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attāti.
mn35:20.18: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
mn35:20.20: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn35:20.21: etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attāti.
mn35:21.2: yo nu kho dukkhaṃ allīno dukkhaṃ upagato dukkhaṃ ajjhosito, dukkhaṃ “etaṃ mama, eso hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassati, api nu kho so sāmaṃ vā dukkhaṃ parijāneyya, dukkhaṃ vā parikkhepetvā vihareyyāti.
mn35:21.6: na nu tvaṃ evaṃ sante dukkhaṃ allīno dukkhaṃ upagato dukkhaṃ ajjhosito, dukkhaṃ
mn35:21.7: “etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassasīti?
mn35:22.1: seyyathāpi aggivessana, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno tikhiṇaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya,
mn35:22.2: so tattha passeyya mahantaṃ kadalikkhandhaṃ ujuṃ navaṃ akukkukajātaṃ,
mn35:22.3: tamenaṃ mūle chindeyya, mūle chetvā agge chindeyya, agge chetvā pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujeyya,
mn35:22.4: so tattha pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujanto, pheggumpi nādhigaccheyya, kuto sāraṃ.
mn35:22.5: evameva kho tvaṃ aggivessana mayā sakasmiṃ vāde samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno ritto tuccho aparaddho.
mn35:22.6: bhāsitā kho pana te esā aggivessana, vesāliyaṃ parisatiṃ vācā
mn35:22.7: “nāhantaṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇācariyaṃ api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
mn35:22.8: thūṇaṃ cepahaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ; sāpi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya,
mn35:22.10: tuyhaṃ kho panaggivessana appekaccāni sedaphusitāni nalāṭā muttāni uttarāsaṅgaṃ vinibhinditvā bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhitāni.
mn35:22.11: “mayhaṃ kho panaggivessana, natthi etarahi kāyasmiṃ sedo”ti. –
mn35:22.12: iti bhagavā tasmiṃ parisatiṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ kāyaṃ vivari.
mn35:22.13: evaṃ vutte saccako nigaṇṭhaputto tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
mn35:23.1: atha kho dummukho licchaviputto saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:23.4: “seyyathāpi bhante gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre pokkharaṇī,
mn35:23.6: atha kho bhante sambahulā kumārakā vā kumārikā vā tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā nikkhamitvā yena sā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkameyyuṃ, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogahetvā taṃ kakkaṭakaṃ udakā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpeyyuṃ,
mn35:23.7: yaññadeva hi so bhante kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya, tantadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā saṃchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ,
mn35:23.8: evaṃ hi so bhante kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi saṃchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ puna otarituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe.
mn35:23.9: evameva kho bhante yāni saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici, tāni bhagavatā sañchinnāni sambhaggāni sampalibhaggāni.
mn35:23.10: abhabbovadāti bhante saccako nigaṇṭhaputto puna bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ yadidaṃ vādādhippāyo”ti.
mn35:24.1: evaṃ vutte saccako nigaṇṭhaputto dummukhaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:24.2: “āgamehi tvaṃ dummukha. mukharosi tvaṃ dummukha. na mayaṃ tayā saddhiṃ mantema. idha mayaṃ bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ mantema.”
mn35:24.3: “tiṭṭhatesā bho gotama, amhākañceva aññesañca puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācā.
mn35:24.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvako sāsanakaro hoti ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane viharatī”ti?
mn35:24.6: idha aggivessana mama sāvako yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ “netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
mn35:24.10: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ “netaṃ mama, neso hamasmi, na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati;
mn35:24.11: ettāvatā kho aggivessana mama sāvako sāsanakaro hoti ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane viharatīti.
mn35:25.1: “kittāvatā pana bho gotama bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto”ti?
mn35:25.2: idha aggivessana bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgata paccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, neso hamasmi, na meso attā’ti, evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anupādā vimutto hoti.
mn35:25.6: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti, evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anupādāvimutto hoti.
mn35:25.7: ettāvatā kho aggivessana bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto.
mn35:26.1: evaṃ vimutta citto kho aggivessana bhikkhu tīhi anuttariyehi samannāgato hoti:
mn35:26.3: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho aggivessana bhikkhu tathāgataññeva sakkaroti, garukaroti, māneti, pūjeti
mn35:26.4: “buddho so bhagavā bodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, danto so bhagavā damathāya dhammaṃ deseti, santo so bhagavā samathāya dhammaṃ deseti, tiṇṇo so bhagavā taraṇāya dhammaṃ deseti, parinibbuto so bhagavā parinibbānāya dhammaṃ desetī”ti.
mn35:27.1: evaṃ vutte saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:27.2: “mayameva bho gotama dhaṃsī, mayaṃ pagabbhā, ye mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimha.
mn35:27.3: siyā hi bho gotama hatthippabhinnaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo, na tveva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo.
mn35:27.4: siyā hi bho gotama pajjalitaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo, na tveva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo.
mn35:27.5: siyā hi bho gotama āsīvisaṃ ghoravisaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo, na tveva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo.
mn35:27.6: mayameva bho gotama dhaṃsī, mayaṃ pagabbhā, ye mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimha.
mn35:27.7: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
mn35:28.1: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā te licchavī āmantesi:
mn35:28.2: “suṇantu me bhonto licchavī, samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattena saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
mn35:28.3: tena me abhihareyyātha yamassa patirūpaṃ maññeyyāthā”ti.
mn35:29.1: atha kho te licchavī tassā rattiyā accayena saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa pañcamattāni thālipākasatāni bhattābhihāraṃ abhihariṃsu.
mn35:29.2: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto sake ārāme paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
mn35:30.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa ārāmo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
mn35:30.2: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn35:30.3: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn35:30.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn35:30.5: yamidaṃ bho gotama dāne puññaṃ puññamhī ca, taṃ dāyakānaṃ sukhāya hotūti.
mn35:30.6: “yaṃ kho aggivessana tādisaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ āgamma avītarāgaṃ avītadosaṃ avītamohaṃ, taṃ dāyakānaṃ bhavissati.
mn35:30.7: yaṃ kho aggivessana mādisaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ āgamma vītarāgaṃ vītadosaṃ vītamohaṃ, taṃ tuyhaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
